fact: In September 2025 a TAMISEMI official said collecting through the old LGRCIS breached government directives, and Bahi District Council's ICT head said all its revenue sources had been configured and were now collected through TAUSI, after the CAG found 16 councils collected TZS 6.68 billion through LGRCIS in 2023/24.
title: Wataalamu Waeleza Changamoto Zitokanazo na Halmashauri Kutotumia Mfumo wa TAUSI Kikamilifu: Huweza Kusababisha Mapato Kupotea
